channel.title: Room to Expand — Writing
channel.description: Reflections on the body, the work, and what somatic practice is actually like, from Sean Paul Denny at Room to Expand in Berlin.

item.title: Washing the Dishes
item.description: On learning patience at the kitchen sink: washing the dishes to be present, not to get them done, and a practice you get to keep everywhere else.

item.title: As Is
item.description: On the parts we build to survive, renegotiating them instead of fighting them, and what it means to be accepted as is.

item.title: The Power of And
item.description: On emotional capacity: the room you have for what you're actually feeling, and why holding more than one feeling at once changes everything.

item.title: Allow
item.description: A word tattooed on my hand, the games industry, and what it means to hold non-judgmental space for whoever is in front of you.

item.title: The Box
item.description: For a long time, I couldn't order a coffee. A story about a box, somatic work, and learning that it is okay to take up space.
